items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: While his playing reflects the influences of Johnny Hodges and Charlie Parker

ctx.x: Charles McPherson has been one of the top alto saxophonists in jazz since the 1960s. He was born in Joplin, Missouri on July 24, 1939 and moved to New York City at the age of 20. One of his first gigs was with bassist Charles Mingus, and this fruitful relationship lasted until 1974. While his playing reflects the influences of Johnny Hodges and Charlie Parker, he has developed a distinctive character on the alto that has in turn influenced numerous younger saxophone artists. Crouch states, “McPherson never lets us forget the actual greatness of the art he represents.”
